Lightpanda — upstream source reference (AGPLv3)
================================================

This product uses the Lightpanda headless browser as a separate,
runtime-provisioned component. The Lightpanda binary is NOT bundled in the
installer; it is downloaded and verified on first browser use.

Component name:     Lightpanda
Exact version:      0.3.7
License:            GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0)
Upstream project:   https://github.com/lightpanda-io/browser
Source reference:   https://github.com/lightpanda-io/browser (tag 0.3.7)

Distributed artifact (unmodified upstream release binary):
  Platform:         x86_64-linux
  Asset URL:        https://github.com/lightpanda-io/browser/releases/download/0.3.7/lightpanda-x86_64-linux
  SHA-256:          895339b02205171a181dde743ae0068bb4564884076feac8482baca9c212aa5a

Modification status: UNMODIFIED. The binary is the exact, unmodified artifact
published by the Lightpanda project at the release tag above, verified against
the official SHA-256 digest before use.

AGPLv3 obligations:
  Lightpanda is licensed under the GNU AGPLv3. The complete corresponding
  machine-readable source code for Lightpanda 0.3.7 is available from the
  upstream repository at https://github.com/lightpanda-io/browser. A copy of
  the GNU AGPLv3 license text is available at
  https://www.gnu.org/licenses/agpl-3.0.txt and from the upstream repository.
  This product keeps Lightpanda as a separate process/runtime component and
  does not repackage or modify the binary.

Runtime provisioning:
  The Lightpanda binary and the managed Linux rootfs are downloaded separately
  after installation and are not included in the NSIS installer. See
  THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and src-tauri/resources/lightpanda-runtime-manifest.json.
